people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”
translations.bsb: That day David feared the LORD and asked, “How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me?”
translations.kjv: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
translations.asv: And David was afraid of Jehovah that day; and he said, How shall the ark of Jehovah come unto me?
